rows.en: Of course! I'm in too!

But…

we have no idea what kind of power the Shocker Riders have, you know?
There's no guarantee we'll come back alive.
So? You think we're going to back down?
That's fine! We're not backing down.
Once they've made up their minds, there's no stopping them, you know?
Shocker Rider No. 1!!
Shocker Rider No. 2!!
Shocker Rider No. 3!!
Shocker Rider No. 4!!
Shocker Rider No. 5!!
Shocker Rider No. 6!!
Shocker Riders!?
There were six of them!?
Let's show them what the real thing can do!
Rider 1, Rider 2…
The fakes are all dead!
The fakes are all dead!
Fakes are no match for the real thing, after all!
Fakes are no match for the real thing, after all!
Fufufu… Fools! Look closely! Behold my other face…
Hyeeeh, hyeeeh!
General Black is Hiru-Chameleon!?
General Black is Hiru-Chameleon!?

I knew it… The executives of Shocker and Gel-Shocker have always been monsters!

Now, hand over the case!!

I knew it… The executives of Shocker and Gel-Shocker have always been monsters!

Now, hand over the case!!

Fufufu…

The time is right! My role is finished… For glory, I choose death!

Rider, listen well! The one who laughs last… ugh… the one who laughs last… is Gel-Shocker!!

Glory… to our great Leader!!
General Black is dead…
The executives of Shocker and Gel-Shocker were all brave in their own way…
All that's left… is the Great Leader himself!
Mm…
At last… we'll find out who Gel-Shocker's Great Leader really is.
Using the computer in this Gel-Shocker base, it's a sure thing! I'm switching it on now.
Gentlemen… So you've finally made it this far?
That's the Great Leader's voice…
As of today, your organization will be disbanded.

Disbanded?

Don't make me laugh! As long as your organization exists, we'll never disband!

Because of you, Gel-Shocker has been wiped out!

Normally, I would drag you along with me on the road to hell…

Hahaha… I have reorganized my final organization, "Destron"… I will conquer the world without fail!

And you will never set eyes on me, ever! Hahahaha…
Come out! Great Leader!
Hahaha… To begin with, I'll have my archenemy, Kamen Rider, eliminated!
Try it if you think you can!
Hahahaha…
Destron… That's what the Great Leader said, right?
So a new organization has appeared…

The Anti-Shocker League folks say they'll investigate this Destron too!

They're hardly showing themselves, but we can't let our guard down against whatever comes next.

Mm…

By the way, where's Hongo?
He said something about meeting a junior of his from university. I think… it was a guy named Shiro Kazami.
Shiro Kazami?
Kuh…
Takeshi! What happened? Are you all right?

Yeah…

But… this guy's… Kazami's… Kazami's whole family was murdered!
They're terrifying…

Destron…! This is their doing, isn't it?

Son! Hey, son… are you all right?

………

As of today… I'm casting away my humanity!

I'll become a demon of revenge and avenge my father and the others, no matter what!!

Kamen Rider! I'm begging you, make me… make me a cyborg!!

Kazami… I understand how you feel, I really do.

But… I can't lend my power to a personal vendetta!
But I…

The two of us are all the cyborgs the world needs…

Being human, yet not human. That suffering… is more than enough for just the two of us!
We'll do the fighting!

Kazami…

If anything were to happen to you… your late parents and your sister could never rest in peace.
Damn it… If that's how it is, I'll do it on my own!
Hey, wait! Don't do anything reckless!
Dad, Mom, Yukiko… I swear I'll avenge you!
Y-you're…!? The one from that time…?

Scissoooors!! My name is Scissors Jaguar!

Death comes to all who see our Destron! Die, Shiro Kazami!
Scissors Jaguar, you say? You're the one who killed my family! …I won't forgive you, I'll never forgive you, Scissors Jaguar!!
Uwaaagh!!
Kazami!!
Damn! Were we too late?
Scissoooors!! I'll be taking Shiro Kazami! Hahaha…
You!? Who are you?
Farewell! Scissoooors!
Wait! Scissors Jaguar!!
What now, Hongo?
Right, we'll go after him too!
Kazami! Where are you? Kazami!
Damn… Destron!! Is nobody here?
Welcome… Kamen Rider 1, Kamen Rider 2!
That voice!? Gel-Shocker's Great Leader?
Gel-Shocker's Great Leader was merely one of my guises! I told you, didn't I? That I had reorganized as Destron…

uncertain: U04362/U04371: the Great Leader referred to as 'himself'/male by default for a Kamen Rider villain; the source has no pronoun.
U04367: 諸君 rendered 'Gentlemen' (mixed group present; could be 'All of you').
U04386: Tobei addresses Kazami as 君 ('son').
